text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ――Oh, you came at just the right time.

During a lunch break,
I was walking around 
school when I ran in to Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind modeling for my Croquis
drawing?

If I recall,
Croquis was usually a 『Simple sketch 
in a short amount of time』.
Basically to create a 
『Snapshot』 of rough shapes and movements.
choice_data_list: So, abstract isn't your only style
So, abstract isn't your only style

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ……Of course it isn't.

I happened to notice another drawing board
leaning against a tree. 
You could tell she was skilled at just a
glance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What?

There were several pictures stacked
together. 
They were very realistic, and strangely,
you could 
almost feel the atmosphere coming from
them……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Are you finished yet?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A perfect tableau,
requires perfect scrutiny.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
With only passion, love just becomes ego. 
Races are the same……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Alright……over there.

『Change poses every 30 seconds』 is what she
said as 
she set the alarm on her smartphone and
started drawing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
……observing is more important than
drawing. 
Take a look……

What she showed me was multiple human-shaped
figures drawn with simple lines.
Eyes and noses were barely 
drawn and the faces only had two intersecting
lines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Is that so? ――We're continuing.

――And now we were about 20 poses in. 
We should be almost done, right……?

I didn't really know much about drawing
anyways. After thinking for a bit,
a few ideas came to 
mind,
based on paintings I had seen before……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's………… Heh……

It was a pose from a painting about races
done by a famous painter from my hometown.
I fell in love with 
it the moment I saw it in some local official
building.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm……I love it too. That painting.

I couldn't help but speak passionately.
The painting 
was not only beautiful,
but it was about the racing 
world. Each brush stroke was beautiful――!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: …………I see.

Before I realized it, Mejiro Ramonu had 
packed up her tools as the afternoon bell
rang.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It's fine? I don't see an issue……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: With that kind of love……

However, several days after that. 
While we were discussing the schedule as
usual――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ……So, you won't be here on these days.
choice_data_list: Heading back home for a bit

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I don't know where it is but……it must be far,
huh.

I just told her about my hometown recently
too. 
But for her,
I guess it was something unimportant.

But that didn't matter.
Just being together 
because we had the same aspirations was
enough……!
